title: orchis coriophora var. sancta
intro: Orchis coriophora var. sancta, commonly known as the Pyrenean Orchis, is a variety of the Orchis coriophora plant, which is a type of terrestrial orchid. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the Pyrenean Orchis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat certain types of infections. The bioactive constituents of Orchis coriophora var. sancta include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
